title: Choose the home composition
question: The roll dealt three typography-led compositions for the home page, all inside the locked Signal world (navy / bone / gold, Source Serif 4). Each sketch shows the real first viewport with your real posts. Lock one.

options.label: The Dispatch Ledger
options.thesis: The archive is the hero: gold year numerals as section marks, each post a dated ledger row with mono metadata and hairline rules.
options.viewport: Navy full-bleed. Mono brand line and hairline gold rule, one italic standfirst sentence, then 2025 in huge gold serif with entries beneath, 2024 below.
options.risk: Reads dry if entry rhythm is flat; the standfirst and excerpt on the lead entry must carry voice.

options.label: The Contents Page
options.thesis: Home as a periodical's front page: centered serif nameplate with gold dot, gold double rule, numbered contents list with dates.
options.viewport: Bone canvas. Corner metadata lines, huge centered Nhut Duong. masthead, gold double rule with nav, numbered essay list with lead entry enlarged.
options.risk: The most classic take; centered masthead can feel static if the lead entry doesn't pull the eye down.

options.label: The Typographic Poster
options.thesis: The name at poster scale anchors the page; role in mono caps; writing lives in a bottom index strip — boldest scale contrast of the hand.
options.viewport: Navy full-bleed. Small mono top line, Nhut / Duong. set at ~170px serif, role row beneath, bottom third is the latest-writing index with the newest post largest.
options.risk: The giant name centers the person over the writing; the index strip must keep essays primary.
